purpose: Teach: 劣等/集権/旋回/発声/強大/果敢/残存/掟

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員に劣等感を抱かせるな
lines.en: Never let our people feel inferior.
lines.style: Direct command, clipped attack. Measured authority. Eyes steady. The tone of someone accustomed to being heard. No room for negotiation, but not unkind.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。意思決定の集権化と分権化のバランスを取ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll balance centralized and distributed decision-making.
lines.style: Crisp agreement. Professional cadence, steady breath. Acknowledging the directive while already planning implementation. Shoulders forward slightly—showing readiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社内会議を旋回的に各部署で回せ
lines.en: Rotate our internal meetings across departments.
lines.style: Another instruction, issued with the same measured authority. Slightly slower than the first—giving it weight. Expectation of compliance is absolute.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の発声トレーニングをプレゼン研修に入れました
lines.en: Yes. I've already incorporated voice training into our presentation workshops.
lines.style: Quick, factual report. Slight lift at the end—showing he's already ahead. Professional but not stiff. A small note of readiness that suggests competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、強大な競合にも臆するな
lines.en: Don't hesitate in the face of strong competitors.
lines.style: Firmest yet. Sharp attack on the opening syllable. Conviction underneath. The voice of a leader who has watched hesitation cost companies before. Held breath, then release.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。果敢な投資判断を続けます
lines.en: Yes. We'll continue making bold investment decisions.
lines.style: Matching the tone—no flinch. Steady, assured. The response of someone who understands what's being asked and accepts it. Quiet confidence, no bravado.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、不要な部署が残存しないよう整理しろ
lines.en: Eliminate any departments that aren't pulling their weight.
lines.style: Most direct yet. No hedging. Measured but unmerciful. The tone of someone making hard choices and expecting others to execute them without flinching or complaint.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界の掟を弁えつつ新風を吹き込みます
lines.en: Understood. We'll honor industry standards while bringing fresh ideas.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Slower pace—this is the closing statement. Shows comprehension of competing demands: respect for tradition, hunger for innovation. A promise delivered with full understanding of its weight.
